## Summary

There are two distinct image-token encodings in this repo: logos use base64 data URIs, while icons use percent-encoded (`utf8`) data URIs. Both are wrapped in CSS `url(...)` and declared with `syntax: "<image>"`.

## 1. Logos — base64 data URIs

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/logos/generated/logos.css`** — CSS custom properties, one per logo:
```
--instui-logo-canvas-horizontal-color: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB2aWV3Qm94...");
```
Format: `url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,<base64 SVG>")`. NOT percent-encoded — base64.

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/logos/generated/embedded.ts`** — the `LOGOS: LogoMeta[]` array holds only metadata (`product`, `layout`, `colorMode`, `name`, `path` like `"canvas/horizontal-color.svg"`), plus `LOGO_SVGS` and `LOGOS_CSS` exports. Raw SVGs live in `/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/logos/assets/logos/<product>/*.svg`.

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/logos/src/index.ts`** — `getLogoDataUri()` (line ~149) builds the value: `data:image/svg+xml;base64,${Buffer.from(svg).toString("base64")}`. Same base64 logic in the generator **`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/logos/scripts/generate.ts`** (line 83).

## 2. Icons (simple-icons / IR `<image>` tokens) — percent-encoded utf8 data URIs

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/plugins/pantoken/simple-icons/src/index.ts`** (line 158) — token value:
```
value: `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svgOf(icon))}')`,
syntax: "<image>",
meta: { kind: "icon" },
```
Format: `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<percent-encoded SVG>')`. These are the `--instui-icon-*` tokens.

## 3. Icon glyphs — how icon values are represented

Icons are stored as inline SVG (`<path d>`, plus line/circle/rect/polyline/polygon) that gets percent-encoded into the data URI above. They are NOT unicode glyphs at the token level. Downstream consumers decode back to SVG:
- **`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/formats/icons/src/index.ts`** — `@pantoken/icons`, decodes `dataUri` → inline `svg`, exposes `viewBox`, `bidirectional`, `source` ("custom" | "lucide").
- **`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/packages/core/src/icon-assets.ts`** — `decodeIconSvg()` / `getIconSvgs()`, plus SVG→Android VectorDrawable, Xcode imageset, Flutter manifest converters.
- Unicode only appears in the icon-FONT build (**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/formats/icon-font/src/build.ts`**), which assigns Private Use Area codepoints (U+E000+) when generating a font — a separate output format, not the token value.

## 4. Alert (and other components) — image tokens via indirection, one inline percent-encoded URI

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/formats/components/src/components/alert.css`** does NOT store data URIs directly; it references icon tokens through a custom property used as a mask:
```
--pantoken-alert-glyph: var(--instui-icon-info);      /* also circle-check, triangle-alert, octagon-x */
-webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-alert-glyph) center / 1.125rem no-repeat;
```
The `@cssproperty --pantoken-alert-glyph <url>` is documented as "a url-encoded SVG."

**`/Users/dwahl/Scripts/pantoken/formats/components/src/lib/helpers.ts`** — two inline percent-encoded (NOT base64) data URIs for cases that can't use `var()`/masking:
- `SELECT_CHEVRON` (line 53): `url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg...%3E")` — a `background-image` with a color baked into `stroke='%236a7883'` (a native `<select>` can't read `currentColor`).
- `AI_ICON_MASK` (line 64): same `url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg...")` form, used as a mask.
- `iconMask(name)` (line 47) returns `var(--instui-icon-${name}) center / contain no-repeat` — the normal indirection path.

## 4b. Encoding style + existing decode/encode utilities

- **Two encodings coexist:** logos = `;base64,` (not percent-encoded); icons + component helper URIs = percent-encoded via `encodeURIComponent` (icons use `;utf8,`; the helpers.ts inline ones omit `;utf8` and hand-write `%3C…`).

input.plan: # Render image-valued tokens inline in the docs API tables ## Context The CSS API reference pages render token tables where some values are images encoded as data URIs — icons (`url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg…')`, `stroke="currentColor"`), logos (`url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,…")`), and a few component-helper masks. Today those cells show only the raw, unreadable encoded string. The goal: beneath any such value, render the actual image on its own line so the reader sees what the token paints — for the tokens-consumed tables (e.g. [alert.md](docs/api/css/alert.md)), the logos "Custom properties" table ([logos.md](docs/api/css/logos.md)), and anywhere else a `data:image` URI appears. ## How the tables are produced (why this approach) The tables are plain GFM markdown, emitted by the external `@cssdoc/markdown` package and checked in under `docs/api/css/*.md` (plus `docs/hu/…` locale clones). Value cells are backticked code spans (`code(info.value)`) with **no per-cell hook or Vue component** to extend. The value string is the full data URI — nothing is truncated. The established seam for augmenting these pages at compile time is a **markdown-it plugin registered in [docs/.vitepress/config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts:404)**, exactly like `demoMarkdownIt` (from `@pantoken/demo`, wired at line 406). A content-based detector fires on any code span whose text contains `data:image/…`, so it covers every table shape at once (tokens-consumed Value column, logos Default column, and the hu/ clones) with no per-file edits. Chosen rendering: **inline the decoded SVG** (confirmed with the user). Inlining lets `currentColor` icons inherit the theme text color, so they stay visible in both light and dark — an `` would render them black and near-invisible on the dark theme. ## Implementation ### 1. New local markdown-it plugin Add `docs/.vitepress/plugins/token-image-preview.ts` (co-located with the existing `docs/.vitepress/plugins/vitepress-mermaid/`). Export a plugin `tokenImagePreview(md)` that overrides `md.renderer.rules.code_inline` (wrap the default renderer, as `demoMarkdownIt` wraps `fence`): - Run the default `code_inline` renderer to get the normal `…`. - Test the token's raw content for a data-image URI: `url\(\s*['"]?(data:image\/[^'")\s]+)`. Guard non-`image/svg+xml` types by falling back to an `` for that case. - Return `…` followed by a block preview: `…decoded SVG…`. The `` is `display:block`, so it lands on a new line below the value inside the ``. - Sanitize defensively: strip any `

Both gates pass. Color swatches are done.

## What I added

Extended the docs preview plugin to also resolve color values, and renamed it to match its broader role.

- **Single color** (`#E62429`, `rgba(…)`, `transparent`, `#00000000`) → one swatch chip.
- **`light-dark(a, b)`** → two chips labeled **Light** and **Dark**, both branches painted at once so you don't have to toggle themes.
- **Whole-cell only** — a `light-dark(rgba…)` buried inside a box-shadow value gets no swatch (verified: `--instui-elevation-above` shows nothing).
- Each chip sits over a neutral checkerboard so translucent colors read as translucent.

**Files:**
- `docs/.vitepress/plugins/token-value-preview.ts` — replaces `token-image-preview.ts`; one `code_inline` override does images first, then colors (top-level comma split so `rgba(…)` args survive; tight color validation before anything hits a `style` attribute).
- [config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts) — import/use updated to `tokenValuePreview`.
- [pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css) — `.pantoken-swatch` styles (formatter reflowed the multi-value backgrounds).

## Verification (dev server, port 5199)

- **alert**: `light-dark(#ffffff, #171B21)` → Light `rgb(255,255,255)` + Dark `rgb(23,27,33)`; `#E62429` → single `rgb(230,36,41)`; the box-shadow row → no swatch; icons still preview. 11 swatches + 4 image previews.
- **color**: 72 swatches, **0 false positives** (every swatch is on a color value), **0 missed** whole-cell colors; non-color rows (`1.5rem`, `0.0625rem`) untouched.
- No console errors. Screenshot confirms the Light/Dark labeling and single chips render correctly.

Full gate green: `vp run ready:all` and `vp run gate:publish` both pass. Working tree is just the plugin file (new), `config.ts`, `pantoken.css`, and `.claude/launch.json`. Ready to commit on your say-so.
